newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mikoh in deal on Woolmark labeling.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mikoh in deal on Woolmark labeling.

text.p: Optical memory developer Mikoh Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it had signed a one-year agreement with the International Wool Secretariat (IWS) for the supply of anti-counterfeit security labels for use in China and India.
Under the agreement Mikoh will supply seven mm by seven mm foil labels, which will be affixed to a swing ticket bearing the Woolmark symbol, Mikoh managing director Peter Atherton told Reuters.
The foil contains a tamper-proof optical image which is easily verified using a hand-held viewer, he said.
Mikoh planned to supply about 24 million foils under the agreement, although the actual figure could vary depending on the requirements of the IWS, Atherton said.
Atherton declined to place a value on the supply agreement.
The IWS has estimated that in China's 15 largest cities, about 10 to 15 percent of Woolmark products were fakes.
